description:
socket cap screw DIN912 M6x20
What it is: A steel socket cap screw, 6mm in diameter and 20mm long, which is a finished part used for fastening.
reason: The description clearly states 'socket cap screw', which falls under 'Screws, bolts, nuts, coach screws, screw hooks, rivets, cotters, cotter-pins, washers (including spring washers) and similar articles, of iron or steel' in heading 7318.
